source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The typo correction keeps the JavaScript variable policyPreferences in camelCase. Two reviewers reject the accidental all-lowercase replacement, and the final source retains the internal policy-property/stored-preference mapping. This is evidence for the affected variable family. It does not authorize renaming persisted preference keys or exporting JavaScript casing to other languages. No notification tests ran.
title: Spelling fixes preserve camelCase in notification policy variables
